Miami Digital Marketing • SEO • Ads • Website • AI Search

Miami Digital Marketing Agency for Local & Growing Businesses

Growing a business in Miami takes more than a website and more than one channel. Customers compare businesses across Google Search, Google Maps, reviews, ads, and AI-assisted search before they call, and the businesses that win coordinate those channels around one goal: qualified leads, patients, or customers. FixWebsiteIssues.com, the technical SEO and digital marketing division of WevTEC, gives Miami-Dade businesses one plan and one set of numbers across SEO, Local SEO, Google Ads, website management, conversion, content, analytics, and AI Search Optimization. We serve Miami clients remotely from Houston, with specialty teams for healthcare, dental, aesthetics, and small business.

SEO + Local SEO + Google Ads + Website Management + AI Search | One Plan, One Set of Numbers | Houston-Based, Serving Miami Remotely Since 2013

Each discipline has its own page with the detail; this hub explains how they fit together and which a business needs first.

What a Digital Marketing Agency Does for a Miami Business

A digital marketing agency coordinates the channels a business is found through, organic search, Google Maps, paid search, its website, content, and increasingly AI-assisted search, around a single measurable goal, and manages the technical foundation that all of them depend on. The value is not in any one channel; it is in one plan, one set of numbers, and no channel quietly undoing another.

In practice that means: an audit that establishes where the business stands across every channel; a technical foundation that can carry the rest; SEO and Local SEO for durable visibility; Google Ads for immediate volume where the economics work; content that matches how Miami customers search, in English and, where justified, Spanish; conversion work so the visit becomes a call; maintenance so the gains hold; and reporting that a business owner can read. FixWebsiteIssues delivers this with specialty teams, because a Coral Gables cardiology group, a Brickell med spa, a Kendall dental office, and a Doral cleaning company need different things from the same disciplines.

Which discipline first?

  • Site is broken, slow, or hacked: maintenance and repair first
  • Invisible in Google and Maps: SEO and Local SEO
  • Need customers this month: Google Ads, with landing pages
  • Traffic but no calls: conversion work
  • Competitors named in AI answers: AI Search Optimization
  • All of the above: the audit decides the order

Miami Marketing by Industry

Dedicated pages for the industries with the most specific needs; the small business page covers trades, restaurants, real estate, law, automotive, and more.

Healthcare & Medical Practices

Physicians, specialists, clinics, urgent care, and multi-location groups: patient-journey SEO, practitioner listings, policy-aware Ads, bilingual content, AI readiness.

Miami healthcare marketing →

Dental Practices

Neighborhood-level dentist searches, service pages for implants, veneers, aligners, emergency, Maps, Ads, and appointment conversion.

Miami dental marketing →

Med Spas & Aesthetic Clinics

Treatment-level SEO, Maps, reviews, policy-aware Ads, and booking conversion in one of the most competitive aesthetic markets in the U.S.

Miami med spa marketing →

Plastic Surgery Practices

Procedure-specific journeys, surgeon profiles, national and local intent, reputation, and consultation conversion.

Miami plastic surgery marketing →

Small Businesses & Trades

Cleaning, remodeling, construction, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, automotive, restaurants, law, real estate, ecommerce, professional services.

Miami small business marketing →

Any Miami Business

Start with the SEO page for the discipline that underpins everything else, or with maintenance if the site needs stabilizing first.

Miami SEO services →

How the Channels Work Together

Each channel has a different job and a different timeline. Run separately, they compete for the same searches and produce reports that disagree; run together, the search-term data from Ads tells SEO which pages to build, SEO reduces the Ads budget over time, maintenance protects both, and AI-search readiness rides on the same clarity that makes SEO work.

Our Miami Digital Marketing Process

Eight stages in the order that prevents wasted spend. Paid campaigns are not launched until landing pages and tracking exist; content is not written until Google can read the site.

Start With a Free Audit
  1. Marketing and visibility auditWebsite, technical SEO, Google Search, Maps, Ads history, content, competitors, and AI-search presence, with evidence.
  2. Customer search researchHow Miami customers phrase the searches that lead to calls, by service, neighborhood, and language.
  3. Website and technical foundationRepairs, speed, security, architecture, and conversion paths, done by our engineers.
  4. SEO and contentService, location, and industry pages built and linked; educational content where it earns its place.
  5. Local SEO and Google MapsBusiness Profile, citations, reviews, and location pages brought into agreement.
  6. Google AdsCampaigns by service and geography with dedicated landing pages, launched once tracking is live.
  7. AI search readinessEntity clarity, direct answers, corroboration, and crawler access.
  8. Measurement and optimizationOne monthly report on qualified leads by channel; budget and effort moved to what is working.

Digital Marketing Across Miami-Dade

Miami customers search by neighborhood, and the mix of channels shifts with the area. All work is remote; FixWebsiteIssues has no Miami office.

Brickell and Downtown

Professional services, finance, legal, concierge healthcare, and aesthetics. Heavy Maps and Ads competition; reviews and precise location signals decide.

Coral Gables and South Miami

Healthcare, dental, legal, and real estate practices with established reputations; SEO and credentials outperform promotions.

Doral and Hialeah

Trades, logistics, automotive, healthcare, and small business with a large Spanish-speaking customer base; bilingual SEO and Ads are frequently decisive.

Kendall and West Kendall

Family healthcare, dental, home services, and consumer businesses; Maps presence and “near me” intent drive most first calls.

Miami Beach, Wynwood, Coconut Grove

Hospitality, restaurants, retail, wellness, and aesthetics with seasonal, multilingual demand; reviews, hours, and speed carry unusual weight.

Aventura and North Miami

Retail, medical, dental, and aesthetics with affluent customers and competition from Broward; location precision matters.

How We Measure Marketing Performance

Cost per qualified lead across every channel is the number that matters. A Miami business can double its traffic and gain nothing; it can add a handful of neighborhood rankings and a well-run Ads campaign and fill its calendar. Reporting is one monthly document an owner can read: tracked calls, forms, bookings, and purchases by source; Business Profile actions; non-brand organic visibility for the searches that matter; Ads cost per lead; conversion rates by page; technical health; and AI visibility observations recorded as observations.

What we will not report as a win

  • Traffic from searches that never convert
  • Rankings for terms nobody in Miami searches
  • Impressions without clicks or calls
  • Ads clicks without a tracked lead
  • “AI rankings,” which do not exist; we record observations

Not Sure Which Channel Your Miami Business Needs First?

The audit answers that with evidence: where you appear today across Google, Maps, Ads, and AI search, what is broken, and what to fix first.

Request a Free Miami Marketing Audit

Why Miami Businesses Work With FixWebsiteIssues / WevTEC

FixWebsiteIssues.com is the technical SEO, website repair, and digital marketing division of WevTEC, based in Houston and operating since 2013. Miami clients are served remotely with secure access; we do not have a Miami office and do not claim one.

  • One team for the website, SEO, Ads, and AI search, measured against one qualified-lead number.
  • Website repair depth: we fix broken, hacked, and slow sites every week, so the foundation is handled by engineers.
  • Specialty teams for healthcare, dental, aesthetics, and small business, each with its own Miami page.
  • Bilingual-aware marketing for a market where a large share of customers search in Spanish; professional Spanish content, never machine translation.
  • Transparent pricing and month-to-month terms.
  • Candor: what cannot be guaranteed is stated on every page.

What does a digital marketing agency in Miami do?

It coordinates the channels a business is found through, SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, the website, content, and AI-assisted search, around one measurable goal, and manages the technical foundation they depend on. The value is one plan and one set of numbers.

Which service should a Miami business start with?

It depends on the problem. A broken or slow site starts with maintenance; invisibility starts with SEO and Local SEO; a need for customers this month starts with Google Ads; traffic without calls starts with conversion work. The audit decides the order with evidence.

How much does digital marketing cost in Miami?

It ranges from a few hundred dollars per month for maintenance and basic SEO to several thousand for a coordinated program with Ads. We quote after a free audit so the scope reflects the actual work; there is no single package price.

Can SEO and Google Ads run together?

Yes, and they should share one set of conversion numbers. Ads produce immediate visibility while SEO builds, Ads search-term data informs which pages to build, and SEO reduces the paid budget over time.

Do you serve Spanish-speaking customers?

We build professionally written Spanish content, campaigns, and listings for businesses whose customers genuinely search in Spanish, common in Doral, Hialeah, Kendall, and west Miami-Dade. We never use machine translation.

Do you have an office in Miami?

No. FixWebsiteIssues is based in Houston, Texas, and serves Miami-Dade businesses remotely with secure access, the same way every market outside Houston is served.

What is AI Search Optimization?

Making a business clear, consistent, crawlable, and corroborated enough that AI-assisted search systems can understand what it does and where it is, so it is more likely to be retrieved and referenced. It builds on SEO and cannot be guaranteed.

Do you work with healthcare, dental, and aesthetic businesses?

Yes; each has a dedicated Miami page and a specialty team, because the trust, policy, and patient-journey requirements differ from other industries.

How do you measure results?

Cost per qualified lead across every channel: tracked calls, forms, bookings, and purchases by source, Business Profile actions, non-brand organic visibility, Ads cost per lead, conversion rates, technical health, and recorded AI observations.

Can you take over marketing from another agency?

Yes. We audit what exists, keep what works, document accounts and access, and rebuild what does not, without a forced redesign or a restart from zero.
